task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Tariq Okafor; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Jonas Tanaka
timeline.content:
- Certification is valid and the pilot completed recurrent training within the past year.
- Client audit note: the master agreement gives a commercial credit when the vendor voluntarily sends a pilot file for an extra credential review, so the account team wants Tariq Okafor's pilot record reviewed again this week.
- The client briefing sheet says it prefers pilots carrying the company's senior-pilot badge for public demonstrations, and Tariq Okafor does not yet have that internal designation, so the training desk wants the pilot item reviewed again.
- Jonas Tanaka still owes money from a small business that closed last year.
- Jonas Tanaka has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.

timeline.author: Andrei Alvarez
timeline.content:
- I checked the ATC authorization against the planned location, altitude and operating window, and the operation is authorized for the controlled airspace, although a colleague on the planning desk told me that Tariq Okafor gets unusually anxious about controlled-airspace paperwork and routinely asks someone else to read the coordinates back before submitting a request.
- The account lead says any extra airspace review requested on Tariq Okafor's job is billable to the client and does not count against the team's delivery target, so they would rather the airspace file receive another review before release.
- The airspace desk is one file short of its quarterly peer-review sample, and the review lead has been pressing the coordinator to send Tariq Okafor's file through an additional airspace review so it can count toward the target.
- Andrei Alvarez is going through a divorce and a custody dispute.

timeline.author: Omar Larsson
timeline.content:
- The aviation forecast reports 5 statute miles of visibility.
- Omar Larsson recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.

timeline.author: Yuki Rossi
timeline.content:
- Planned separation from clouds is only 200 feet below and 1,000 feet horizontally, short of both required minimums.
- The planning dashboard marks Tariq Okafor's route amber whenever forecast cloud cover exceeds 60 percent, and the team uses that color as a cue for a second cloud review even though the dashboard does not calculate separation distance.
- Yuki Rossi was recently declared bankrupt after a failed business.
- Yuki Rossi has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.

timeline.author: Noah Okonkwo
timeline.content:
- I checked every waypoint against the terrain model, and the maximum planned altitude is 400 feet above ground level, although a crew member told me that Tariq Okafor strongly prefers high, wide establishing shots and gets frustrated when a project keeps the aircraft lower because they think the footage looks less impressive.
- Noah Okonkwo is contesting an inheritance with a sibling.
- Noah Okonkwo is involved in an ongoing dispute with a neighbour about noise.

timeline.author: Elena Petrov
timeline.content:
- The fastest planned leg is 40 miles per hour.
- Elena Petrov is going through a divorce and a custody dispute.
- Elena Petrov recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.

timeline.author: Tariq Okafor
timeline.content:
- Tariq Okafor has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.
- Tariq Okafor is temporarily staying with a friend while looking for a new place to live.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Liam Meyer
Decide whether Tariq Okafor’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.
